_note: Every count, probability and date the app uses. Researchers change them here, never in code. Counts per person are cue-carrying cards; each family adds `baselinePerFamily` all-baseline presentations per form. Planning values are marked: P1's pilot replaces them (research plan v1, 7.4). If research-plan-v2 changes the card counts, change them here and run `pnpm length`.

timing._source: plan-scripts/cap_fit.py, planning values in seconds at the 80th percentile of players, none sourced; P1 replaces them

targets._source: research plan v1, 4.1 (single panel session); the two-game split is re-priced by plan v2

panel-g1._fit: At plan v1's targets this game takes 37.5 minutes at 25 s a card. To fit 30 it ships with plan v1 4.4's alternative (A), put to the applicant as Q-3 (M1-H's players skip the second half; nobody else has Off the Record), and NPT given first in the registered card order (4 to 2 cue-carrying, below E1-N's floor). The rematch is kept. Plan v2 decides.

firm._fit: S2's Inbox gives two cards at a time (PF-18) from its target of 48 until the session fits: 42 (21 and 21) with the content note and the direct block's repeat pairs counted.

split._note: PLANNING VALUE. The screening block's fairness score (0 unfair to 1 fair) below which a player is a low scorer. P1 fixes it at its pilot's 30th percentile.

m1h._note: PLANNING VALUE: share of high scorers drawn into M1-H's statement route.

m3._note: PLANNING VALUES (PO-1): the floor quantile q and the permutation counts.

rc._note: PLANNING VALUE: share of Game 2 players who also take module RC.

release._note: DEMO dates. Each deployment's release date is the day after its whole play window closes.
